inventory.visualPurpose: The RECEPTOR / G-PROTEIN CLASS / MAJOR FUNCTIONS table (the page's first printed element — the 14-row receptor-to-class map)
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The page's table, verbatim, 14 receptor rows under 5 family groups: Adrenergic — α1 'q', α2 'i', β1 's', β2 's', β3 's'; Cholinergic — M1 'q', M2 'i', M3 'q'; Dopamine — D1 's', D2 'i'; Histamine — H1 'q', H2 's'; Vasopressin — V1 'q', V2 's' — each with its MAJOR FUNCTIONS string (α1 vascular/pupillary/sphincter contraction; α2 ↓ sympathetic outflow/insulin/lipolysis, ↑ platelet aggregation, ↓ aqueous humor; β1 '(one heart)' + renin; β2 '(two lungs)' vasodilation/bronchodilation/tocolysis/K+ uptake; β3 lipolysis/thermogenesis/bladder relaxation; M1 cognitive/enteric/exocrine; M2 ↓ heart rate, AV node conduction, atrial contractility; M3 exocrine/peristalsis/bladder/broncho/vasodilation/miosis/accommodation; D1 renal vascular + direct pathway; D2 transmitter + indirect pathway; H1 bronchoconstriction/mucus/permeability/pruritus; H2 gastric acid; V1 vascular contraction; V2 aquaporin-2 + vWF, printing the book's own red-ink erratum overlay 'twobules (tubules)'). Pure text — no rasters.

inventory.visualPurpose: The three cascade diagrams — Gq, Gs, Gi (the page's second printed element: ligand + receptor chip → G protein → enzyme → second messenger → effector, one panel per class)
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: THREE VECTOR cascade panels, labels in the text layer (ZERO rasters on the page — pdfimages returns no rows; vector typeset artwork, COPYRIGHTED, never reproduced): the Gq panel — 'H1, α1, V1, M1, or M3 receptor' → 'Gq protein' → 'Phospholipase C' → 'PIP2' → 'IP3' + 'DAG' → 'Ca2+' → 'Protein kinase C' → 'Smooth muscle contraction' (with 'Myosin light-chain kinase (smooth muscle contraction)'); the Gs panel — 'B1, B2, B3, D1, H2, or V2 receptor' → 'GS protein' → 'Adenylyl cyclase' → 'ATP' → 'Cyclic AMP' → 'Protein kinase A' (+ 'Ca2+'); the Gi panel — 'M2, α2, or D2 receptor' → 'Gi protein' → 'Adenylyl cyclase' (inhibited) → ↓ 'Cyclic AMP'. The diagram text layer duplicates every label (two-layer artwork) and prints 'B1, B2, B3' where the table prints β glyphs. Conveyed as ONE original KYP schematic (the three cascade panels with the receptor-example chips per class) — no artwork reproduced.
